sections.heading: What It Is
sections.body: Work-Integrated Learning (WIL) at PTI is mandatory industrial attachment: after a minimum of 9 months of training (or sooner, depending on ability), every trainee is placed with an industry or workplace partner for further hands-on exposure directly related to their course.

sections.heading: Why It Matters
sections.body: Classroom and production-unit training builds the base skill; WIL puts that skill to work in a real organisation, under real workplace conditions and expectations — closing the gap between training and employment.

sections.heading: What You Leave With
sections.body: On successful completion, trainees receive a testimonial from their industrial attachment partner, in addition to their DIT and UBTEB certificates — evidence of real workplace experience, not just classroom learning.
